system.description: Starting at 17th Level, your skill as a Seeker has become mythical, rivaling sages and huntsmen of legend. Whenever you score a hit against a creature marked with your Vector Seal, you can spend 3 Discipline, causing your [Weapon Damage] to be treated as the maximum possible value. If this damage reduces a creature classed as a Standard or Elite to 50 or fewer hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw, or instantly by reduced to 0 hit points. If the creature is classed as a Solo, it makes its constitution saving throw at advantage.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
